description: Source code implementing the USB Power Delivery Protocol Layer (PRL) in Zephyr OS, including state machines for message transmission, hard reset handling, and message reception.

methods.name: prl_subsys_init
methods.description: Initializes the Protocol Layer state machines and enters suspend states.

methods.name: prl_is_running
methods.description: Checks if the Protocol Layer state machines are active.

methods.name: prl_execute_hard_reset
methods.description: Triggers a hard reset sequence from the Policy Engine.

methods.name: prl_hard_reset_complete
methods.description: Indicates completion of a hard reset to the Protocol Layer.

methods.name: prl_send_ctrl_msg
methods.description: Constructs and transmits a control message.

methods.name: prl_send_data_msg
methods.description: Constructs and transmits a data message.

methods.name: prl_set_default_pd_revision
methods.description: Resets all packet type revisions to default (highest supported).

methods.name: prl_start
methods.description: Activates the Protocol Layer state machines.

methods.name: prl_suspend
methods.description: Pauses the Protocol Layer state machines.

methods.name: prl_reset
methods.description: Resets the Protocol Layer state machines to initial state.

methods.name: prl_first_msg_notificaiton
methods.description: Notifies the Protocol Layer that the first AMS message is being sent.

methods.name: prl_run
methods.description: Runs the Protocol Layer state machines, handling message transmission and reception.

methods.name: prl_set_rev
methods.description: Sets the revision for a specific packet type.

methods.name: prl_get_rev
methods.description: Retrieves the revision for a specific packet type.
